provider.name: Interim Register of Marine and Nonmarine Genera
provider.organization_type: global marine and nonmarine taxonomic-name, genus-register, classification, source, identifier, environment, web-service, and data-integration infrastructure
provider.description: The Interim Register of Marine and Nonmarine Genera is a global taxonomic resource covering accepted and unaccepted genera, species and higher taxa across marine and nonmarine environments. It provides Aphia identifiers, accepted-name relationships, synonymy, hierarchy, authorship, environment flags, fossil status, bibliographic sources, statistics, REST web services, downloads, and cross-links to major taxonomic authorities.
institutional_context: World Register of Marine Species and global taxonomic-data community

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting IRMNG documentation, taxonomic records, hierarchy, accepted names, synonyms, identifiers, environment flags, sources, statistics, REST services, downloads, standards, licenses, citations, related authorities, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: IRMNG, VLIZ, LifeWatch Belgium, Aphia, its source datasets, cited publications, and related taxonomic authorities remain authoritative for names, classifications, statuses, identifiers, environment flags, sources, versions, licenses, and contacts.
